short_title: ECB technical working document for CON/2026/10

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Cellar WORK_CREATED_BY_AGENT identifies the European Central Bank; the exact PDF is headed ECB-PUBLIC.
Exact OP catalogue card for IMMC TWD/2026/10 explicitly states Published 2026-03-13.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Verified official English drafting proposals formally linked by EUR-Lex to ECB Opinion CON/2026/10.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The attachment status and annex_to edge are analytical classifications for a separate companion, not a claim that the five-page TWD is literally annexed inside the authentic OJ opinion. The exact OP card asserts Published 13 March 2026; this is not treated as proof of first EUR-Lex availability. The ECB bulletin of 20 March concerns future publication of the opinion, Cellar repository creation occurred later, and the opinion's authentic OJ publication was 15 April; none replaces the TWD catalogue assertion.
